Our Story

The spice route,
reimagined.

Chef Arjun Mehra spent seven years tracing the old trade routes — Kerala to Kashmir, Amritsar to Goa — before opening Qissa in Mayfair. Every spice here is single-origin, hand-milled, and toasted the morning it is used.

Our Craft

Rooted in origin.

Eighteen single-origin spices, sourced from the farms that grew them and milled in-house each morning. When our growers prosper, so does the plate.
